```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
```


```{r}
# Folder paths (UPDATE if needed)
multiple_phone_folder <- "/home/supraja/BRSM/Project/Attention Task Validation/data_brsm/multiple/phone"
single_phone_folder   <- "/home/supraja/BRSM/Project/Attention Task Validation/data_brsm/single/phone"

# File lists
multiple_phone_files <- list.files(multiple_phone_folder, pattern="\\.csv$", full.names=TRUE)
single_phone_files   <- list.files(single_phone_folder, pattern="\\.csv$", full.names=TRUE)

# Read multiple-target phone data
multiple_phone_data <- map_df(multiple_phone_files, function(file) {
  df <- read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  df$SourceFile <- basename(file)
  df$TaskType <- "Multiple"
  df
})

# Read single-target phone data
single_phone_data <- map_df(single_phone_files, function(file) {
  df <- read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  df$SourceFile <- basename(file)
  df$TaskType <- "Single"
  df
})

# Combine
phone_raw <- bind_rows(multiple_phone_data, single_phone_data)
```

```{r}
phone_data <- phone_raw %>%
  mutate(
    DeviceType = "Phone",
    Level = as.numeric(Level),
    InitialResponseTime_ms = as.numeric(`InitialResponseTime(ms)`),
    SourceFile = sub("_.*", "", SourceFile)
  ) %>%
  filter(Completed == TRUE) %>%
  select(SourceFile, TaskType, DeviceType, Level, InitialResponseTime_ms)

head(phone_data)
```


```{r}
multiple_lab_folder <- "/home/supraja/BRSM/Project/Attention Task Validation/data_brsm/multiple/lab"
single_lab_folder   <- "/home/supraja/BRSM/Project/Attention Task Validation/data_brsm/single/lab"

read_lab_data <- function(folder, task_type) {
  
  files <- list.files(folder, pattern="\\.csv$", full.names=TRUE)
  
  data_list <- lapply(files, function(file) {
    
    df <- read.csv(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    
    # 🔹 Keep only valid trials (removes junk first row automatically)
    df <- df[!is.na(df$trials.thisN) & df$trials.thisN != "", ]
    
    # 🔹 Clean mouse.time
    clean_time <- df$mouse.time
    clean_time[clean_time == "" | clean_time == "None" | clean_time == "[]"] <- NA
    
    # Extract first RT
    first_rt <- as.numeric(sub("\\[([0-9.]+).*", "\\1", clean_time))
    
    data.frame(
      SourceFile = sub("_.*", "", basename(file)),
      TaskType = task_type,
      DeviceType = "Lab",
      Level = as.numeric(df$trials.thisN),
      InitialResponseTime_ms = first_rt * 1000
    ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(InitialResponseTime_ms))   # remove bad RT rows
  })
  
  bind_rows(data_list)
}

# Read lab datasets
multiple_lab_data <- read_lab_data(multiple_lab_folder, "Multiple")
single_lab_data   <- read_lab_data(single_lab_folder, "Single")

lab_data <- bind_rows(multiple_lab_data, single_lab_data)
head(lab_data)
```


```{r}
combined_data <- bind_rows(phone_data, lab_data)
combined_data <- combined_data %>%
  mutate(
    DeviceType = factor(DeviceType),
    TaskType   = factor(TaskType),
    Level      = as.numeric(Level)
  ) %>%
  filter(InitialResponseTime_ms > 0)

combined_data <- combined_data %>%
  mutate(
    TrialIndex = ifelse(DeviceType == "Lab", Level, NA),
    Difficulty = ifelse(DeviceType == "Phone", Level, NA)
  )

head(combined_data)
```
```{r}
str(combined_data)
summary(combined_data)
head(combined_data)
```


GLM CODE:

```{r}
lab_only <- combined_data %>%
  filter(DeviceType == "Lab")

glm_lab_learning <- glm(
  InitialResponseTime_ms ~ TaskType * TrialIndex,
  family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  data = lab_only
)

summary(glm_lab_learning)

phone_only <- combined_data %>%
  filter(DeviceType == "Phone")

glm_phone_difficulty <- glm(
  InitialResponseTime_ms ~ TaskType * Difficulty,
  family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  data = phone_only
)

summary(glm_phone_difficulty)
```

```{r}
glm_platform <- glm(
  InitialResponseTime_ms ~ DeviceType * TaskType,
  family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  data = combined_data
)

summary(glm_platform)
```


HYPOTHESIS PLOTS:

```{r}

# --- H1 Panel A: Phone GLM at mean difficulty ---
h1_phone <- expand.grid(
  TaskType = levels(phone_only$TaskType),
  Difficulty = mean(phone_only$Difficulty)
)

pred_phone <- predict(glm_phone_difficulty, 
                      newdata = h1_phone, 
                      type = "link", 
                      se.fit = TRUE)

h1_phone$pred  <- exp(pred_phone$fit)
h1_phone$lower <- exp(pred_phone$fit - 1.96 * pred_phone$se.fit)
h1_phone$upper <- exp(pred_phone$fit + 1.96 * pred_phone$se.fit)
h1_phone$Model <- "Phone GLM (at mean difficulty)"

# --- H1 Panel B: Combined GLM, Lab device only ---
h1_combined <- expand.grid(
  DeviceType = "Lab",
  TaskType = levels(combined_data$TaskType)
)

pred_combined <- predict(glm_platform, 
                         newdata = h1_combined, 
                         type = "link", 
                         se.fit = TRUE)

h1_combined$pred  <- exp(pred_combined$fit)
h1_combined$lower <- exp(pred_combined$fit - 1.96 * pred_combined$se.fit)
h1_combined$upper <- exp(pred_combined$fit + 1.96 * pred_combined$se.fit)
h1_combined$Model <- "Combined GLM (Lab only)"

# --- Combine and plot ---
h1_all <- bind_rows(
  h1_phone[, c("TaskType", "pred", "lower", "upper", "Model")],
  h1_combined[, c("TaskType", "pred", "lower", "upper", "Model")]
)

ggplot(h1_all, aes(x = TaskType, y = pred, color = TaskType)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~Model) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(
    title = "H1 (GLM): Predicted IRT by Task Type",
    subtitle = "H1 predicted Multiple > Single — neither model supports this",
    x = "Task Type",
    y = "Predicted IRT (ms)",
    color = "Task Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```


```{r}
h2_data <- expand.grid(
  DeviceType = levels(combined_data$DeviceType),
  TaskType = levels(combined_data$TaskType)
)

pred <- predict(glm_platform, newdata = h2_data, type = "link", se.fit = TRUE)

h2_data$fit <- pred$fit
h2_data$se  <- pred$se.fit

# Convert from log scale
h2_data$pred  <- exp(h2_data$fit)
h2_data$lower <- exp(h2_data$fit - 1.96 * h2_data$se)
h2_data$upper <- exp(h2_data$fit + 1.96 * h2_data$se)

ggplot(h2_data, aes(x = DeviceType, y = pred, color = TaskType, group = TaskType)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, position = position_dodge(width = 0.3)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
                width = 0.2,
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.3)) +
  geom_line(position = position_dodge(width = 0.3)) +
  labs(
    title = "H2 (GLM): Platform Differences in Response Time",
    x = "Device Type",
    y = "Predicted Response Time (ms)",
    color = "Task Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
h3_data <- expand.grid(
  TrialIndex = seq(min(lab_only$TrialIndex), max(lab_only$TrialIndex), length.out = 50),
  TaskType = levels(lab_only$TaskType)
)

pred <- predict(glm_lab_learning, newdata = h3_data, type = "link", se.fit = TRUE)

h3_data$fit <- pred$fit
h3_data$se  <- pred$se.fit

# Back-transform from log scale
h3_data$pred  <- exp(h3_data$fit)
h3_data$lower <- exp(h3_data$fit - 1.96 * h3_data$se)
h3_data$upper <- exp(h3_data$fit + 1.96 * h3_data$se)

ggplot(h3_data, aes(x = TrialIndex, y = pred, color = TaskType)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = TaskType), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  labs(
    title = "H3 (GLM): Learning Effect Across Trials",
    x = "Trial Index",
    y = "Predicted Response Time (ms)",
    color = "Task Type",
    fill = "Task Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
phone_only$resid_sq <- residuals(glm_phone_difficulty, type = "response")^2

glm_h4_single <- glm(resid_sq ~ Difficulty, 
                      data = phone_only[phone_only$TaskType == "Single",],
                      family = Gamma(link = "log"))

glm_h4_multi <- glm(resid_sq ~ Difficulty, 
                     data = phone_only[phone_only$TaskType == "Multiple",],
                     family = Gamma(link = "log"))



h4_pred <- expand.grid(
  Difficulty = seq(min(phone_only$Difficulty), max(phone_only$Difficulty), length.out = 50),
  TaskType = levels(phone_only$TaskType)
)
h4_pred$fit <- NA
h4_pred$se  <- NA

# Single
pred_single <- predict(glm_h4_single,
                       newdata = h4_pred[h4_pred$TaskType == "Single",],
                       type = "link",
                       se.fit = TRUE)

h4_pred$fit[h4_pred$TaskType == "Single"] <- pred_single$fit
h4_pred$se[h4_pred$TaskType == "Single"]  <- pred_single$se.fit

# Multiple
pred_multi <- predict(glm_h4_multi,
                      newdata = h4_pred[h4_pred$TaskType == "Multiple",],
                      type = "link",
                      se.fit = TRUE)

h4_pred$fit[h4_pred$TaskType == "Multiple"] <- pred_multi$fit
h4_pred$se[h4_pred$TaskType == "Multiple"]  <- pred_multi$se.fit
h4_pred$pred  <- exp(h4_pred$fit)
h4_pred$lower <- exp(h4_pred$fit - 1.96 * h4_pred$se)
h4_pred$upper <- exp(h4_pred$fit + 1.96 * h4_pred$se)

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = phone_only,
             aes(x = Difficulty, y = resid_sq),
             alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(data = h4_pred,
            aes(x = Difficulty, y = pred, color = TaskType),
            linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_ribbon(data = h4_pred,
              aes(x = Difficulty, ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = TaskType),
              alpha = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~TaskType) +
  labs(
    title = "H4 (GLM): Variability vs Difficulty by Task Type",
    x = "Difficulty",
    y = "Squared Residuals (variance proxy)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
